topic: A person's invention is already patented by someone else
text: I’ve heard tales of a man who thought he’d come up with a new way to mill grain, only to find out another had already crossed that bridge. It’s the way of things, I reckon. Just like sowing seeds in spring, thinking you’re the first to plant this patch, only to remember the earth has been tilled before. It’s a shame, aye, but not the end of the world. There’s always another way to turn a good idea into something useful. Maybe mixing in different grains, or crafting a tool to help with another chore on the farm. The saints have many paths, and when one is blocked, there’s always another. Best to look at what’s been done and see where your hands can bring a new twist.
